faq.q: Welche Spiele eignen sich gut für ältere Menschen?
faq.a: Gute Spiele sind einfach, vertraut und ohne Druck: große Bilder zum Zuordnen, Sortieren, leichte Puzzles, das Ergänzen bekannter Sprichwörter, Ausmalen, Bilder-Bingo und Gesprächskarten. Sie passen zu vielen älteren Menschen, auch zu Menschen mit Demenz. Die beste Wahl ist das Spiel, das der Person heute Freude macht. Vermeiden Sie Zeitlimits, Punkte und alles, was sich wie eine Prüfung anfühlt.

En-in. Angîâ kue na ambeti sô alingbi mo sigi na nî na ndö tî Creative Activities ayeke senge senge, compte ayeke dä pëpe, hûndango tî sû iri ayeke dä pëpe, wala tî téléchargé ye pëpe. Angîâ nî ayeke tambela na yâ tî navigateur internet na ndö tî téléphone, tablette wala ordinateur.

faq.q: Angîâ tî bibe alingbi tî kanga lege na kobela tî girisângo li?
faq.a: Es ist kein Spiel nachgewiesen, das Demenz verhindert, und Creative Activities behauptet nicht, etwas zu behandeln oder zu verhindern. Unsere Spiele dienen dem Vergnügen und der gemeinsamen Zeit, und keine Aktivitätsseite macht gesundheitsbezogene Aussagen.

faq.q: Angîâ sô alingbi na mbeni zo sô ayeke na kobela tî Alzheimer?
faq.a: En-in. Kobela tî Alzheimer ayeke ye sô aga mingi na kobela tî girisângo li, na e leke angîâ sô ngbanga tî lo: akotâ fötö sô angbâ tî bâ nî, asôro ayeke gbä pëpe, na mbeni ye tî bata na bê wala tî sara fôte ayeke dä pëpe. Hakango afötö, sôrôngö aye na hunzîngö atënë tî ândö abâ ye sô zo ahinga ândö na mbage tî finî mandango ye.

faq.q: Mbeni zo sô kobela tî girisângo li tî lo alï mingi awe alingbi tî sara akua tî ngîâ sô?
faq.a: Mingini, en-in, sô zo ayeke na terê tî lo. To ndâ nî na Gi sô akpa mba na afötö use, Amba tî fötö na akarte osïo, mbeni lembi tî fîngö kûlëre wala kêtê ngoi tî hôngö pupu kpô. Sara si ngoi nî aningba pëpe, mû lege sô lo ye, na kaî na ngoi sô lo wara nî alingbi awe.

faq.q: A yeke bata atënë tî mbi nzönî?
faq.a: Site nî ayeke na account pëpe na publicité ayeke dä pëpe. E yeke sara kua na Google Analytics tî hinga alembi sô azo ague dä. Afötö sô mo sôro ngbanga tî Amba tî fötö ayeke sigi gi na yâ tî navigateur tî mo na e yeke gue na nî na ndö tî internet lâ oko pëpe.

faq.q: Azo wa la aleke Creative Activities?
faq.a: Creative Activities ist ein kleines Team, das ruhige, kreative Aktivitäten für Erwachsene entwickelt, für alle, die jemanden begleiten, im Web und als kostenlose App. Wir sind keine Ärztinnen und Ärzte, und nichts hier ist medizinischer Rat.

about.bodyHtml:
À qui s'adresse ce site

À toute personne qui prend soin de quelqu'un : un parent, un grand-parent, un enfant, un conjoint, un ami, ou une personne atteinte de démence. Les familles, les personnes âgées et le personnel d'animation peuvent tous utiliser les mêmes pages.

Ce que nous croyons

L'intérêt d'une activité, c'est le moment lui-même : une conversation, un sourire, la satisfaction de rassembler deux images, ou simplement d'être assis l'un près de l'autre. Il ne s'agit ni d'évaluer quelqu'un, ni de le pousser plus loin, ni de prouver quoi que ce soit.

De nombreuses applications d'entraînement cérébral reposent sur la rapidité, les scores, les séries et les niveaux. Pour une personne fatiguée, malade ou atteinte de démence, cela peut ressembler à un examen qu'elle ne peut pas réussir. Nous avons conçu l'inverse, et nous nous imposons les règles suivantes :

  • Rien à rater. Pas d'horloge, de score, de compteur de coups, de vies, de séries, de confettis ni de compte à rebours, sur aucun écran.
  • La reconnaissance plutôt que le rappel. Les images restent affichées par défaut. Les invitations encouragent la conversation et ne testent jamais les prénoms ou les souvenirs.
  • Grand, simple et stable. Textes et images de grande taille, contraste élevé, et commandes qui restent à leur place.
  • La dignité de l'adulte. Des images tirées du réel et des mots simples et chaleureux. Ni dessins animés, ni éloges chantants, ni récompenses en émojis.
  • Une sortie facile. « Terminé pour le moment » est toujours visible. Arrêter à mi-parcours est une bonne issue.
  • Privé par défaut. Ni comptes, ni publicité. Les photos que vous choisissez restent sur votre appareil.

Ce que nous n'affirmons pas

Nos jeux et activités sont destinés au plaisir et au lien social. Ils ne diagnostiquent, ne testent, ne mesurent, ne traitent, ne ralentissent ni ne préviennent la démence ou la maladie d'Alzheimer, et personne ne devrait les choisir pour cette raison. Lorsque nous écrivons sur la recherche en santé, nous indiquons clairement où les preuves sont faibles, et nous ne la rattachons jamais à nos propres activités.

Qui nous sommes

Creative Activities est une petite équipe indépendante. Nous ne sommes pas des cliniciens. Nos guides sont rédigés à partir de recommandations publiées par des organisations telles que le National Institute on Aging et l'Alzheimer's Association, et chaque guide énumère ses sources. Lisez comment nous rédigeons et vérifions nos pages.

Dites-nous ce qui pourrait vous aider

Nous serions ravis de savoir ce qui fonctionne pour vous et ce qui ne fonctionne pas, surtout de la part des personnes atteintes de démence, des aidants familiaux et du personnel d'animation. Écrivez à {email}.

editorial.title: Ndo so ahé sara na ye ti pâge ti ahé
editorial.description: Comment Creative Activities recherche, rédige, sélectionne ses sources et met à jour ses pages d'activités et de santé, et ce que nous ne publierons jamais.
editorial.crumb: Tënë ti ye ti pâge ti ahé
editorial.bodyHtml:
Our sources

We base our guides on public guidance from organizations such as the National Institute on Aging, the CDC, the Alzheimer’s Association, the Alzheimer’s Foundation of America, the Family Caregiver Alliance and the NHS, and on peer-reviewed research such as Cochrane reviews and large clinical trials. Every guide lists the sources it relies on. We open each source before citing it, and we only report what it actually says.

How we write

  • Practical first: what to do today, in plain language.
  • Honest about evidence: we say “linked with”, “may” and “the evidence is mixed” when that is the truth.
  • Respectful: we write about people living with dementia as adults, and we never use quizzing or shaming language.
  • No invented content: no made-up statistics, quotes, experts, studies, reviews or testimonials.

Who reviews our pages

Pages are written and checked by the Creative Activities team. Some drafting and research use AI tools, as described below. Every page is checked against its sources by the team. Our pages have not been reviewed by a doctor or other clinician, and we do not claim otherwise. They are general information, not medical advice.

How AI is used

We use AI tools to help with research, first drafts, translation drafts and formatting. A person edits every page against its sources. AI does not test activities: a person tries each activity before it is published. No AI-generated step, image or review is presented as verified, and we do not publish AI-written reviews or testimonials. No generated image is shown as a photo of a real activity.

What we will never publish

  • Claims that a game, food, supplement, fast or routine prevents, treats, slows or cures dementia.
  • Tests, quizzes or scores that suggest someone has, or does not have, dementia.
  • Advice to start, stop or change any medicine.
  • Advertising or sponsored content disguised as guidance.

Updates and corrections

Each page shows the date it was last updated. If you find a mistake or an out-of-date source, please email {email} and we will check it promptly.

faq.crumb: Ye so a tâ na ye so ahé ayeke tënë
faq.lede: Tënë ti kpe na ye ti nzoni, ye so ndo ti ahé ayeke tâ mingi.

items.q: Quels sont les meilleurs jeux pour les personnes âgées ?
items.a: The best games are familiar, simple and free of pressure, and the right one is whatever the person enjoys today. Picture matching with visible pictures, sorting, easy jigsaws, finishing familiar sayings, coloring and picture bingo all work well for many people. Avoid timers, scores and anything that feels like a test.

items.q: Jeux ni ayeke pëpe kua ti ngu tî ahé ayeke na lâ?
items.a: Ee. Yanga kue na yanga ti ngu hunda ayeke pëpe na ndo ti ngu: a yeke pëpe ti sara akonte, pëpe ti zia nda, pëpe ti kiri ngu, na pëpe publicité.

items.q: Na nyen la a yeke ape ti score, niveau nga timer?
items.a: Vitesse nga score ayeke sara yanga nzapa ti examen, so ayeke mû sioni nga ngangu ti azo. Mbeni ti ngangu ayeke ti nzapa na ngia ti ngo ti kpe, na ti sara ye ti ngu ti lo nzoni. Mo lo ayeke ti zia ye na ndo kue ti lo ye ti ngu ape ti lo.

items.q: Ngu nyen so ayeke nzoni mingi?
items.a: Telefon, tablette nga ordinateur so ayeke na navigateur ti web ti sô ti ndara. Tablette so ayeke na support na tablé ayeke nzoni mingi ti azo ôko na ôko ti nzapa ye ti ngu na ndo ti tabla. Ordinateur so ayeke na télé ayeke nzoni ti azo ti ngu ti ngbâ.

items.q: Can we play with our own family photos?
items.a: Ee. Jeu ti photo pairs ayeke sara 2 na 6 photo so mo lo ayeke sô ti sara jeu ti kâ ti ngu. Photo ayeke na navigateur ti mo nga ayeke ti ngu ape ti ngu nga ayeke ti zia ape.

groups.title: Yanga ti ngu nga ti ngbâ azo

items.q: Yanga so ayeke ti lo na tere ti ngu ayeke mingi nga?
items.a: Ngu ayeke sara 10 na 20 minute ayeke ti nzoni, na mbeni ngu 2 minute ayeke ti nzoni mingi. Tene ti sioni ti lo ti kpe ngangu nga ti ndoro, na zia na ngu ti lo ayeke mû ye ti nzoni. Ndo ti tene ti lo ti ngu ape ti na tere ti nzapa.

items.q: Tongana ala ayeke mû yanga ape ti ngu?
items.a: Respect the no, and try again later or in a different way. Refusal can come from tiredness, pain, feeling unsure or simply not being interested. See our guide on what to do when they say no.

items.q: Yanga nyen so ayeke nzoni ti azo na maladi ti dementia ti kpale?
items.a: Comfort and the senses: listening to favorite music, hand massage with lotion, looking at photos together, holding a soft blanket, sitting outside, or a very simple picture game with someone beside them. Our later-stage guide has many more ideas.

items.q: Are there activities for groups in a care home?
items.a: Yes. Picture bingo has printable cards and an on-screen caller, and Finish the saying and Conversation cards work well read aloud. Our care home groups guide covers group size, seating and adapting for mixed abilities.

items.q: Jeu wala ngu ayeke kpe wala ngbâ dementia ape?
items.a: Jeu ôko ti ngu ape a sara ye ti fa ti kpe dementia, na jeu ti biso ayeke sara ye ti tene ape pëpe. Stimulation ti sioni na ndo ti azo ayeke fa ndoro ti nzoni ti ngu na recherche ti azo so ayeke na maladi ti dementia ti kete na ti ngbâ, mais ye so ayeke pëpe ti jeu ti kpe maladi. Ambeni jeu ayeke ti ngu na ngangu ti mbeni na kua ti ngu.

items.q: A ayeke mû ti kpe dementia ape?
items.a: Ape na ngbanga ti nzapa. Recherche ayeke fa 14 yanga ti ngangu nga ti lo ti azo so ayeke linked na risque ti dementia, tongana kpe ti ndoro, pression ti ngangu ti ndo, ndo ti ngu pëpe, na ngbâ ti kiri. Ti ngbâ yanga so ayeke mû ti risque ti lo ti kpe mbeni azo, mais ambeni azo so ayeke sara ye hunda nzoni ayeke ti ngbâ dementia tongana ala. Ndo ti ye ti mbeni azo ape ayeke ti lo ye.

items.q: Intermittent fasting ayeke nzoni ti ngangu ti sioni nga?
items.a: Human evidence is limited and early, and much of the research is in animals. Fasting can be risky for older adults, especially with diabetes medicines or unintended weight loss, and it is not recommended for people living with dementia. Talk with a doctor before changing how you eat.

items.q: A ayeke zia ye ti nzapa nga?
items.a: Akonte pëpe, publicité pëpe. Mbi ayeke na Google Analytics ti tene ye ti azo so ayeke ti sara ngu, na ti tene page so ayeke nzoni. Navigateur ti mo ayeke tene ti soni so mo ayeke fa mû wala pëpe. Photo so mo ayeke sô ti Photo pairs ayeke kue pëpe ti ... ti kpe pëpe. Tene privacy notice ti zo ti tene ti nzapa.

items.q: Ye so ayeke conseil ti medical ?
items.a: Ape. Creative Activities ayeke ti ngu nga ti ngbâ ye ti nzapa. Mbeni ye ti ngangu ti sioni, tene ti doctor. Mbeni kpale, zia secours ti peyi ti mo na ndo ti lo.

Ayeke na site ti lo kue

  • Papier ti sara pëpe: mot ti ngu ti tâ, papier ti ngu ti kulu, karte ti tene, na picture bingo.
  • Ndoro ti yanga ti ngu ti kue ti ngangu, na guide ti ngu ti ndo na ti tene ti lo ye ti nzoni.

Tongana kpengbê ayeke sara na yâ

  • Ndö ti kota kodro na ndö ti demence: picture bingo wala finish-the-saying na TV ti salon ti kpengbê, na mbeni azo ayeke tapa ti kpengbê ti sara.
  • Programme ti azo ti kota ndö na lo: mbeni station na tablette na Picture pairs ti tile 4, pour sessions ti nzoni ti mbeni na mbeni.
  • Bibliothèque ti kpengbê: word searches ti imprimer na kâdo ti tënë na kit ti demence, na site so a sara bookmark na tablette ti bibliothèque.
  • Groupe ti kpale ti yanga na café ti demence: handout ti imprimer ti mbeni page pour azo ti yanga ti zi na yâ ti ndo.
  • Hôpital na azo ti sara sewa ti kiri: handout na paquet ti azo ti yanga, pour mbeni sala ti nzoni ti kpe na yâ ti ndo wala na kâ ti malade.

So e kpe pëpe sara

Jeux ayeke pour ndo na lê ti kpengbê. Ayeke pëpe ti tene, ti sara test, ti score, ti sara fango wala ti kiri demence, na e ayeke ti ndo ti ndö ti kpengbê pëpe ti tene tongana so. Pëpe publicité, na jeux ayeke ti tene pëpe nom, tënë ti yanga wala picture ti a tene ti tongana ti ndö. Site ayeke sara na Google Analytics ti kpale ti zo ti ndö; note ti bê ayeke tene ni nzoni so a kpale. Picture so a sara na Photo pairs ayeke na browser kue.

app.title: Application Creative Activities
app.seoTitle: Application Creative Activities pour iPhone na Android
app.description: Application Creative Activities so ayeke ti fango: matching ti picture na tile 4 ti kue, picture ti familie so ayeke na appareil ti i, pack ti picture so ayeke sara pëpe na internet, na pëpe compte.
app.lede: Ye kue so i ye na site, na mbeni application so ayeke sara pëpe na internet na so ayeke kpe picture ti familie so i yeke ti tiri.
app.bodyHtml:
Start small

Begin with four large tiles and familiar pictures. Keep pictures visible, or hide them when that feels comfortable. Gentle mode has no timer, score or penalty. Choose 4, 6, 8 or 12 tiles.

Make it personal

Select family photos with your device’s photo picker. The app saves smaller copies for its activities. It does not scan your library or change your original photos, and it keeps up to 24 photos in one collection.

Just look together

View one picture at a time. Optional prompts invite conversation without asking anyone to remember names or give a correct answer. Simply looking is enough.

Offline where it matters

Starter pictures and all eight picture packs are included with the app. Imported photo copies work offline. Choosing originals stored only in iCloud may need an internet connection.

No account, no photo-sync server

Family-photo copies stay in the app on the device. You can remove the copies without deleting originals. Device backups may include app data. Read the app privacy policy, and app help walks through each step.
app.disclaimer: Creative Activities ayeke ti gbâ ti mbeni ye ti tâ ngbâ na tënë ti kodro. Lo ayeke diagnostic, ayeke sara ti mbeni wala ayeke ngbâ na dementia wala maladi Alzheimer.

faq.q: Jeux so mo lingbi ti tâ ndo ti kanga?
faq.a: Kodro ôkô na ôkô ti kodro usïö ayeke ndo nzoni ti tâ. Tongana ngbâ kodro ayeke ti ngu na lo, mo lingbi ti tâ Find the same na kodro ûse. Tongana zo ayeke na ngbâ ti tënë, mo lingbi ti tâ Picture bingo.

faq.q: Jeux ayeke sara ye na iPad wala telefôn?
faq.a: Ee. Jeux kue ayeke sara ye na navigateur na telefôn, tablette na ordinateur, na kodro ayeke yanga ti hunda ekran. Tablette ayeke na support ayeke nzoni tongana zo ôko na ûse ayeke ngbâ.

faq.q: Jeux ni ayeke nzoni na zo so ayeke na maladi Alzheimer?
faq.a: Ee. A sara ni na ndo ti zo so ayeke ngbâ na dementia, na Alzheimer kue, so ayeke maladi ti ngbâ kue. Kodro ayeke hunda, ndo ti ngu ayeke ti ngbâ ti lo, ngu ti tâ wala ti sara ye ayeke ti ngbâ, nzoni ayeke na tâ yâ so lo hon ti lo na ngbanga ti tâ kodro so a sara fôto ti yâ so a tî ngbâ ti lo.

faq.q: Are these memory games for seniors?
faq.a: They are matching and picture games that any older adult can enjoy, but they are built not to test memory: in Picture pairs the pictures stay face up unless you choose otherwise. Any memory game can be made gentler by dropping the timer and the scores.

faq.q: Jeux ni ayeke na ndo ti zo mingi na ndo ti lo ti dëngö?
faq.a: Ee. Picture bingo ayeke na kaart ti tî ngbâ na ekran ni ayeke ngbâ kodro, na Finish the saying na Conversation kaart ayeke nzoni tongana ti tënë na ndo ti zo mingi.

appFacts.requirements: iOS 15 wala ndo ti sô; Android 7.0 wala ndo ti sô
appFacts.summary: App ti ndâ ti tî gbâ na iPhone, iPad na Android, na ngbâ kodro ti zo ti sara ye na ndâ-ndâ 4 to 12, ngbâ na tâ fôto ti mo so mo yeke ngbâ, na kodro ti 8 so ayeke na app ni ayeke sara ye na ndo ti internet. Ngu ti kodro wala ngu ti tâ.
features: Ngbâ kodro ti zo na ndâ-ndâ 4, 6, 8 wala 12; kodro ayeke na ndo ti ekran tongana mo tî zi lo

Tâ ndo ti hunda: kodro ôkô na ôkô, na tënë ti sara ye kue
Kodro ti 8 ayeke na app; ayeke sara ye na ndo ti internet
No account, ads, in-app purchases, timer, score or penalty

faq.q: Ayeke na application ti zo ti ngu na famille?
faq.a: Ee. Creative Activities (na ndo ti App Store na Google Play, tî lo « {storeName} ») ayeke ti ndâ ti tî gbâ. Lo ayeke ngbâ kodro ti zo na kodro ti ndâ, jeux na fôto ti mo so mo yeke sara, na kodro ti ndo ti internet ayeke sara ye.

faq.q: Creative Activities app ayeke ti ndâ ti tî gbâ?
faq.a: Ee. Ayeke ti ndâ ti tî gbâ, pëpe na ngu ti tâ, pëpe na compte, pëpe na ngu ti sara ye na app.

faq.q: App ayeke sara ye na ndo ti internet pëpe?
faq.a: Ee. Kodro ti ndâ ti zo na kodro ti 8 so ayeke na app ayeke sara ye ti ngbâ na ndo ti internet, na fôto ti mo ayeke sara ye ti ngbâ tongana ayeke tâ na app. Fôto so ayeke na iCloud gi kue a lingbi ayeke na ndo ti internet.

faq.q: Can I use our own family photos?
faq.a: Ee. Mo lingbi nda photo ti mo na outil ti choisir photo ti ye ti mo. App ayeke sara copie ti photo ni na ye ti mo, nzoni ti jeux ti ni, nga lo ayeke kiri ti tene ti photo ti tâ ni. Lo ayeke ti ngbâ photo ti mo na nzoni ti ni. Mo lingbi zia copie ni na ngoi so mo mû.

faq.q: Is it a brain-training or memory-test app?
faq.a: No. Creative Activities is for enjoyment and time together. It has no scores or tests, and it does not diagnose, treat, prevent or measure dementia or Alzheimer’s disease.

faq.q: Ye ti mo lingbi ti ye ti jeux ti ni ayeke wa?

gameFaqYes.q: Ayeke version app ti jeux so wa?
gameFaqYes.a: Ee. App Creative Activities ti ye ti gbele, ti iPhone, iPad nga Android, ayeke na jeux ti ye ti nzoni ti photo ti tene ti zo, lo lingbi nda photo ti mo ti kiri, nga lo lingbi sara na ndo ti Internet ti ye ti ngbâ. Ayeke sara nzoni, ayeke kua ye ti compte, ni ayeke kua publicité nga ye ti ye ti score.

gameFaqNo.q: Ayeke version app ti jeux so wa?
gameFaqNo.a: Not of this game. The free Creative Activities app for iPhone, iPad and Android has gentle picture matching with large tiles and family photos you choose, and it works offline. This game stays free here in your browser.

print.heading: Sala na papier
print.sameRules: Version ti papier ayeke na mbeni ti yeke na jeu ti écran:
print.pageNote: Mbeni page na A4 wala US Letter, lo ayeke pâ na noir na blanc. Version {date}.
print.islandNote: It prints what is on the screen now. Version {date}.
print.point: On paper, point to a picture instead of tapping it, or circle it with a pen. Each row is a new set.
print.pointTarget: On paper, the picture to look at is in the box at the start of each row. Point to a picture instead of tapping it, or circle it with a pen.
print.halves: Each picture is cut down the middle. Draw a line from each half on the left to the half on the right that fits it, or point with a finger. Nothing needs cutting.
print.grid: Mbeni case ayeke na mbeni nomero. Mbi ti tene nomero ti yeke na key, na ti sala case na mbeni crayon ti yeke ti kiri. Mbeni couleur mo ayeke pâ mbi.
print.colors: Each row names a color. Point to every picture that is that color, or circle it with a pen. Each row is a new set.
print.dice: Mbeni ngu ayeke mbeni ti dice. Mbi ti tene mbeni ngu, wala ti kpe karte na ti yeke na kpe, na ti tënë mbeni tënë na ndo ti tâ. Zo mbeni ayeke pâ ti mbi.
print.words: Cut out the words, or draw a line from each word to its picture. Read the words aloud as you go.
print.cards: Kpe karte na line ti dashed. Mbi ti sara na table na face na ndo, na zo mbi pair ti karte.
print.chain: Na papier, tene karte na ndo ti gbata na ndo ti yâ, mbeni na mbeni. Zo mbeni ayeke na mbeni phrase na karte ti yeke, na mbi karte ti ngbele. Zo mbeni ayeke pâ ti mbi.
print.sort: Kpe karte na line ti dashed, na mbi mbeni na box ti ndo ti lo ayeke.
print.puzzle: Kpe karte ti ngu na line ti dashed na usïö mbeni piece, na fa ti mbi ti kiri. Mbi mbeni piece na ngbele ti mbi karte ti ayeke ti fade. Karte ti kiri ayeke ti guide.
print.cutSafety: Mbeni zo ti yeke na ngangu ayeke sala kpe kpe ti sô. Tongana a fa, mbi ciseaux ti ngbe.

reasons.photos: Ayeke na version ti papier pëpe. Jeu so ayeke na foto ti ngangu ti yeke, foto ti ngbele ayeke na browser ti zo, a yeke pâ tene pëpe, na site ayeke pâ fa na papier. Tongana a yeke sala na papier, fa copies mbeni na mbeni ti foto ti yeke na ndo ti zo na mbi na table.
reasons.paced: Ayeke na version ti papier pëpe. Cercle ayeke mbi ndo ti yâ na écran, na papier ayeke pâ fa so, ti sala mbeni activité mo. Ndo ti tene ti yeke na tënë na zo ti mbi pâ na écran ayeke ngbele.
reasons.turns: Ayeke na version ti papier ti jeu so pëpe. Tongana a yeke sala pair na table, fa karte ti foto na Picture pairs, na zo mbeni ayeke ti yeke ti sara karte.
reasons.screen: Ďi ni ayeeke ti papier. Ayeeke ni a yeke ti mo nzoni na ekran ti mo nzoni ndo; yâ ti ndo ti mo mo nzoni na tâ ndo ni ayeeke ni, wala mbeti ti mo na sese ti mo ngangu.
reasons.wash: Ďi ni ayeeke ti papier. Aquarelle ti papier ayeeke ni: lo sara ndo pinceau ti ngu, nga na ndo ngu ni kue.
reasons.sayings: Ďi ni ayeeke ti papier na tongana. Na papier, ngu kue ayeeke ni ayeke fa nga na nzoni, na pasi ti "Fa ngu ti fini" ayeeke ni ayeke kue. Mo nzoni yâ ti yâ na ekran tongana, wala mo nzoni yâ ti yâ ni so mo na mo nzoni.
